title: Compare the shelf units
hook: Two stated cases: explore the common quantity denominator.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the common quantity denominator affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines UnitCost, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the common quantity denominator in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
